build_proxygen_spec: build a proxygen fbcode builder spec that configures CMake defines and declares dependency modules
configure_cmake_defines: configure CMake defines to disable QUIC, tests, and shared libs for the proxygen build
add_build_dependencies: add build dependencies including gmock, fmt, folly, wangle, fizz, sodium, zstd, and mvfst
run_fb_github_cmake_install: run the fb_github_cmake_install step to build and install proxygen from the Facebook GitHub repo
review_fbcode_builder_spec: review the fbcode_builder_spec function to understand proxygen build configuration and dependency chain
